mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reading_progress WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND book_id=#{bookId} AND chapter_id=#{chapterId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_progress(user_id,book_id,chapter_id,current_paragraph_index,completed_paragraphs,total_paragraphs,total_reading_ms,completed_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{bookId},#{chapterId},#{currentParagraphIndex},#{completedParagraphs},#{totalParagraphs},#{totalReadingMs},#{completedAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_paragraph_index=#{currentParagraphIndex},completed_paragraphs=#{completedParagraphs},total_paragraphs=#{totalParagraphs},total_reading_ms=#{totalReadingMs},completed_at=#{completedAt},updated_at=#{updatedAt}
